title: White Industries Jumps to Light Speed With Its Galaxy Seat Collars and Top Caps
content:
White Industries is bringing a little cosmic awe and wonder with the release of its Limited Edition Galaxy Seat Collars and Top Caps…

“Go strap yourselves in. I’m gonna make the jump to light speed.”

Featuring a distinctive Galaxy finish, these special-edition components add a little out-of-this-world personality to any bike build. And just like the stars in the night sky, no two pieces are exactly alike. Each Seat Collar and Top Cap has its own unique pattern and character, making every one a little piece of the galaxy.

The piece pictured may not be exactly the one you receive, and that’s part of the fun. Precision-machined in Petaluma, California, each component delivers the quality, craftsmanship, and attention to detail that White Industries is known for. This wild anodizing finish was done by the anodizing wizard Ashley Anodized It, so expect these colors to pop!

Available exclusively for the holiday season, the Galaxy collection is being produced in limited quantities. Once they’re gone, they’re gone. No second production run, no return trip around the galaxy.

The Limited Edition Galaxy Seat Collars and Top Caps are available now at Whiteind.com.
